categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Hexin Instrument Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and technical services of mass spectrometers. Its product portfolio includes environmental online monitoring instruments, laboratory analytical instruments, medical instruments and consumables, and customized instruments. The company also provides data analysis and technical operation and maintenance services, focusing on environmental monitoring, food safety, public security, water supply, and medical health sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core mass spectrometry technologies such as high-resolution vertical introduction reflectron time-of-flight mass analyzers, laser source resolution enhancement, bipolar time-of-flight mass spectrometry, multi-stage ion removal pulse technology, and quadrupole filters. It has developed proprietary ion sources including electrospray, electron impact, vacuum ultraviolet photoionization, and laser ablation ionization sources. Production involves strict adherence to manufacturing processes including component design, machining, assembly, vacuum technology, and system debugging, with a shift towards order-driven production planning and supplier optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government ecological environment bureaus, environmental monitoring stations and centers, industrial park management committees, research institutes, and enterprises in environmental monitoring, food safety, public security, water supply, medical health, and industrial process analysis. The company has a strong presence in environmental monitoring, especially for PM2.5, VOCs, and ozone monitoring, and is expanding into food safety, medical diagnostics, and judicial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales concentrated in key provinces and cities, including over 30 provinces and 300 cities using its products. It also has subsidiaries and operations in major Chinese cities such as Guangzhou, Beijing, Shanghai, Kunshan, Taizhou, and Zhuhai. Overseas sales exist but represent a smaller portion of revenue, with a focus on domestic market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hexin Instrument operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of mass spectrometry instruments and providing related technical services. It controls core component manufacturing processes and collaborates with suppliers for non-core parts, emphasizing supplier evaluation and procurement concentration to ensure quality and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes independent innovation and R&D efficiency, focusing on expanding its product line and application scenarios in environmental monitoring, food safety, medical health, and water quality monitoring. It is developing advanced products such as triple quadrupole tandem mass spectrometers, high-resolution mass spectrometers, and rapid screening instruments. The R&D strategy includes project-based management, collaboration with academic and research institutions, and integration of AI and big data technologies to enhance instrument intelligence and data services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct and indirect sales of mass spectrometry instruments and related products, complemented by technical services including data analysis and instrument maintenance. Sales to government and institutional customers are often through bidding and negotiated contracts. The company also earns from after-sales services such as software upgrades, consumables, and repair services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international giants like Thermo Fisher Scientific, Danaher, Agilent, and domestic firms such as Tianrui Instrument, Juguang Technology, and Xuelilong. Hexin Instrument holds a significant position in the domestic mass spectrometry market with approximately 2% overall market share and about 19% among domestic manufacturers. It is recognized as a leading domestic innovator with strong core technology and brand advantages in environmental monitoring mass spectrometers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 202.5 million, a 44.7% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 46 million. Despite revenue decline, the company improved profitability metrics through cost control and operational efficiency. Total assets stood at around RMB 877 million, with net assets of RMB 384 million. R&D investment accounted for 16.2% of revenue, reflecting sustained focus on innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hexin Instrument emphasizes its comprehensive mastery of core mass spectrometry technologies and strong domestic R&D capabilities, enabling it to offer high-performance, domestically produced instruments tailored to local environmental monitoring needs. Its products provide high resolution, sensitivity, and rapid analysis, with unique capabilities in real-time pollution source analysis and multi-component VOCs monitoring. The company also offers integrated data analysis services and localized customer support, differentiating itself from foreign competitors primarily focused on biomedical applications.
